newsitem.title: USA: Snyder buys N.Y. pharmaceutical marketer.
newsitem.headline: Snyder buys N.Y. pharmaceutical marketer.

text.p: Snyder Communications Inc said Monday that it entered the pharmaceutical marketing business with the purchase of Medical Marketing Detailing Inc.
Snyder said it acquired the New York-based firm that provides pharmaceutical marketing services in a pooling of interests for 1.35 million Snyder shares.
The acquisition should be "very accretive" to earnings per share, the company said, but declined to elaborate.

Snyder said Medical Marketing had revenues of $34.5 million for the fiscal year ended October 31. Clients include Bristol-Myers Squibb Co, Bayer AG and the Wyeth-Ayerst unit of American Home Products Corp.
Snyder Communications designs and initiates marketing programs.
